base_window: today 12-m (trailing 12 months as of the Sept 2026 collection)
method: geometric mean of basket members' Adidas-anchored levels
note: Google Search level basket = trends_level_adidas100 / basket_ref_adidas_level * 1000. Basket average = 1000 by construction. FROZEN: future seasons must re-derive the basket over this same base window and normalise to this stored reference. Rescaling is a positive linear transform, so VGR scores/ranks/tiers are unchanged.
